verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents its own human annotation capability: users can attach ground-truth labels in the UI and score traces and spans with human labels. That covers the review-and-labeling half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows annotation queues or any way to route outputs to reviewers, so the workflow side is unproven. Missing for 10: annotation queues, routing or assignment of outputs to reviewers, queue management workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can route outputs to human annotation queues for review and labeling

citations.quote: Human annotations — Attach ground truth labels directly in the UI
You can score traces & spans with LLM-based evaluators, code-based checks, or human labels so you can track performance and identify failures consistently.
